scripts.firebase:emulators:functions:local: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.firebase-config FIREBASE_SKIP_UPDATE_CHECK=true firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth --project zinc-money
scripts.firebase:emulators:reset: sh -c "curl -s -X DELETE 'http://127.0.0.1:9190/emulator/v1/projects/zinc-money/accounts' && curl -s -X DELETE 'http://127.0.0.1:8180/emulator/v1/projects/zinc-money/databases/(default)/documents' && echo 'Emulator Auth + Firestore data cleared.'"
